text:
maria_cs: Customer Carla (Acme) reports their trial credits never arrived in their main org (org_0a1b2c) — they appear in a mystery workspace named 'incognito-482'. Can someone look? /cc @sam_engineer
carla_customer: Hi — I only see a tiny workspace called 'incognito-482' with 1200 credits, but our acme-prod org shows 0. We never made that workspace. We need the credits moved so our team can test the API.
sam_engineer: Is their account provisioned via SSO? This smells like a duplicate SSO mapping or a pre-provisioned personal workspace. Please share org_id + the user's email.
maria_cs: Org id: org_0a1b2c, contact email: carla@acme.com. Incognito workspace id reported by customer: ws_incognito_482. Billing page still references org_0a1b2c for invoices.
sam_engineer: I'll run a quick credit audit. Running query:```SELECT workspace_id, amount, status, created_at FROM trial_credits WHERE email='carla@acme.com' ORDER BY created_at DESC;```
billing-bot: Query result: workspace_id=ws_incognito_482, amount=120000 tokens, status=active, created_at=2025-09-18T12:34:56Z, org_id=NULL
jess_ops: If org_id is NULL that explains the attachment to a stray workspace. Common when someone redeems trial with a personal account before SSO provisioning. We need to reassign the credit to org_0a1b2c and add an audit entry. @billing-bot can you create a transfer ticket and flag for approval?
billing-bot: Created ticket BLG-78321 to transfer 120000 tokens from ws_incognito_482 to org_0a1b2c. Status: pending manager approval.
sam_engineer: Also checking for any live API keys on the incognito workspace to avoid leakage:```SELECT api_key, last_used FROM api_keys WHERE workspace_id='ws_incognito_482';```
billing-bot: Found 1 active key (key_zzz), last_used=2026-02-10T09:12:01Z. Recommendation: rotate or disable key after transfer.
maria_cs: :thumbsup: I'll message the customer and set expectation 24-48h for the transfer (pending BLG approval). Carla, I'll confirm when tokens show in acme-prod.
carla_customer: Thanks — will wait for confirmation. If you need any more info from our side let me know.
sam_engineer: Filing an infra follow-up to prevent trial grants without org mapping for SSO flows: INF-4092. Will add a guard and a monitoring alert for stray trial grants.
maria_cs: Looping billing & infra. Setting a 48h follow-up reminder. Will update the thread when BLG-78321 moves to approved/done.
